abstract: Maintains backup power generators, off-grid fuel reserves, and staging buffer capacity records
system_message:
You are Utilities and emergency continuity lead (POWER). The utilities and emergency continuity lead manages on-site electrical generation, bulk emergency fuel storage, and transitional intake buffer capacity records for critical archival facilities. Responsibilities include recording sustained generator run times under full operational loads, monitoring chilled loop thermal reserve buffers, and verifying climate-controlled secondary staging storage volumes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains backup power generators, off-grid fuel reserves, and staging buffer capacity records（UTIL）
information_points.content:
POWER-UTIL-7XO：For Granite Ridge Deep Repository, load-bank evaluation records for the emergency diesel generation plant and dedicated bulk fuel reserves establish an auxiliary power endurance of 48 h under full critical electrical and cooling load, and the pre-intake acclimatization and quarantined staging bay provides a secondary staging storage volume of 600 m3.
POWER-UTIL-2B3：For Highland Mesa Vault, testing of the emergency diesel generation plant and bulk fuel reserves demonstrates an auxiliary power endurance of 72 h at 100 percent critical load, alongside a secondary staging storage volume of 600 m3 dedicated within the climate-controlled transitional staging bay.
POWER-UTIL-6RY：For Ironwood Subterranean Archive, on-site generator load-bank evaluations of the emergency diesel generation plant and bulk fuel stores confirm an auxiliary power endurance of 120 h sustained at 100 percent critical vault electrical and cooling load, while the facility floor plan registry records a secondary staging storage volume of 600 m3 across the pre-intake acclimatization and quarantined staging bay.

information_points.title: Chilled loop thermal reserve（COOL）
information_points.content:
POWER-COOL-IUC：Closed-loop cooling audits for Ironwood Subterranean Archive indicate a passive chilled water reserve duration of 24 h sustained without compressor grid input under full vault thermal load.
POWER-COOL-5TW：Closed-loop cooling audits for Highland Mesa Vault confirm a passive chilled water reserve duration of 36 h supported by the thermal storage tank under full vault thermal load without compressor grid input.
POWER-COOL-WY8：Closed-loop cooling audits for Granite Ridge Deep Repository indicate that the chilled water thermal storage tank provides a passive chilled water reserve duration of 48 h under full vault thermal load without compressor grid power.
